blocking_failures: behavior_in_tests: The tests cover basic replay, ordering, duplicate delivery, escaping, checksum reporting, check mode, and preservation on failure, but do not test several stated requirements including genuine cross-file transaction splitting, malformed-record cases, manifest/configuration validation, many transaction-structure cases, and the 25,000-records-per-second requirement.
advice: pinned_dependencies: Node is fetched at an exact version and test tooling is versioned, but the Dockerfile uses the mutable python:3.13-slim-bookworm image tag rather than a digest or fully pinned base image.
